title: The Nvidia case is just the latest episode of Trump disregarding intelligence
summary_full: Trump’s reaction to sensitive information that contradicts his worldview mirrors his conduct towards war with IranDonald Trump’s unwillingness to heed warnings of suspected Chinese penetration of the tech giant Nvidia follows a pattern of the US president ignoring sensitive intelligence that contradicts his world view.Trump disregarded repeated information that the company’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, was having an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy that threatened to undermine Washington’s geo-strategically vital goal of pipping China for global supremacy in the artificial intelligence race.
